paite: Huchi in Benjamin in ata masa Bela, azom Ashbel, athumna Aharah asuang;
heading: Benjamin Suante

paite: alina Nohah, angana Rapha ahi.
Bela in tapate anei a, Addar, Gera leh Abihud;
Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah;
Gera, Shephuphan, Huram.
Hiaite Ehud tapate ahi uh: hiaite Geba a tengte pipute inkuan a lupente ahi uh, huchi in amaute Manahath ah sal in api uhi.
Naaman, Ahiah, Gera, amaute sal in api a; Uzza leh Ahihud asuang hi.
Shaharaim in amaute asawlmang nung in, Moab mun ah tapate asuang; azite Hushim leh Baar ahi uh.
Azi Hodesh a pan, Jobab, Zibia, Messa leh Malkam asuang hi;
Jeuz, Sakia, Mirma. Hiaite pipute inkuan a lupente, atapate ahi uhi.
Hushim lak ah Abitub leh Elpaal asuang hi.
Elpaal tapate: Eber, Misham, Shamed, Ono lamkhetu leh Lod, huai khopite toh lampa.
Beriah, Shema, Aijalon, Gath a tengteng delhzakte tengtengte pipute inkuan a lupente ahi uh;
heading: Gath Leh Aijalon A Benjaminte

paite: Ahio, Shakshak, Jeremoth;
Zebadiah, Arad, Edar,
Beriah tapate Mikael, Ishpah, Joha.
Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hezeki, Heber;
heading: Jerusalem A Benjaminte

paite: Ishmerai, Jezliah, Jobab, Elpaal tapate,
Jakim, Zikri, Zabdi;
Elienai, Zilthai, Eliel;
Adaiah, Beraiah, Shimrath, Shimei tapate:
Ishpan, Heber, Eliel;
Abdon, Zikri, Hanan;
Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah;
Ipdeiah, Penuel, Shashak tapate;
Samserai, Shehariah, Athaliah;
Jaaresiah, Eliah, Zikri, Jeroham tapate.
Hiaite akhangte ua pipute inkuan a lupente ahi uh, ahausa makaipente: hiaite Jerusalem ah ateng uhi.
Gibeon ah Gibeon pa ateng a, azi min Maakah ahi:
heading: Gibeon Leh Jerusalem A Benjaminte

paite: Atapa masapen Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab;
Gedor, Ahio, Zaker.
Mikloth in Shimea asuang hi. Anaute uh toh Jerusalem ah a-unaute uh zom ah ateng lai uhi.
Ner in Kish asuang; Kish in Saul asuang; Saul in Jonathan, Malki-shua, Abinadab leh Eshbaal asuang hi.
heading: Kumpipa Saul Inkuan

paite: Jonathan tapa Merib-baal ahi a; Merib-baal in Mikah asuang hi.
Mikah tapate: Pithon, Melek, Tarea leh Ahaz ahi uh.
Ahaz in Jehoaddah asuang; Jehoaddah in Alemeth, Azmaveth leh Zimri asuang; Zimri in Moza asuang;
Moza in Binea asuang; Rapha atapa, Eleasah atapa, Azel atapa:
Azel in tapa guk anei a, amin uh hiaite ahi: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah leh Hanan. Hiaite tengteng Azel tapate ahi.
Unaupa Eshek tapate: Ulam ata masa, Jehush a zom, Eliphelet athumna ahi.
Ulam tapate mihat hangsan, thalkap mite ahi uh, tapate' tapate, tupate tampi, zakhat-le-sawmnga ahi uh. Hiaite tengteng Benjamin tapate ahi uhi.
